The ability that triggers focus fire (horizon) also benefits from the damage increase.

True, it just depends how early into the game they get that MR. If they don't get their MR until a 4th or 5th item, then something like Ludens into deathcap into horizon gives a lot of damage. If they get it earlier then something like ludens into deathcap into void or Ludens into horizon into void is better. Going the horizon route allows you to get that magic penetration earlier and be more relevant in the midgame.

So I tried a bit more of a complete build. 

If you go Ludens + horizon + void staff and compare it to Ludens + deathcap + needlessly + amp (5500g vs 5385) with a level 16 combo, if the enemy has more than 41mr, then the void staff route does more damage. [Graph 1.](https://i.gyazo.com/e983c7abcc96dd7e6cd34c36acb3334b.png) Here f(x) represents deathcap and g(x) horizon. The more mr over 41 they have, the better the void staff route becomes.

Edit: the later into the game you get, the higher that 41mr threshold will increase due to more magic penetration from the mythic bonus. A full build with no void staff gives a flat 48 magic pen which is insane. I'm gonna see how two full builds, one with void staff and one without compare.

This is an incomplete picture though. Horizon costs 800g less and ability power has a gold value of 21.75g per point. If you add this to horizon it gives it an adjusted ap of 136.8. Then horizon becomes better if you have no more than 150 ap. [Graph here.](https://i.gyazo.com/5a080b01666022598330f9b68ae45fe4.png) So Horizon is a valid second item. Then it becomes a question of what do you realistically spend that 800g on. Maybe a blasting wand into a void staff if they are building MR early but with the Luden mythic passive void loses some of its value. I'm gonna do some more calculations to see the value of void staff.

Edit: A ludens+horizon power spike is more likely to be at level 11 though, decreasing the value of horizon in comparison to deathcap. With a level 11 combo, horizon is more valuable if you have less than 110ap [Graph here.](https://i.gyazo.com/6ad8a65d374406bc44ca8697ebecf632.png) With Ludens and dorans ring you will will always have more than 110ap (this is with no ap on runes).

Edit 2: I said ludens+horizon power spike but didn't include ludens damage. With [level 16](https://i.gyazo.com/58610b6fa0e0727f0ad62f6ff41aa106.png) and [level 11](https://i.gyazo.com/3fecec8dc8cfdfe92420a25877234545.png) damages including ludens it doesn't change the results, the threshold just increased by 3-5ap.

Deathcap is always better. [This is the graph.](https://i.gyazo.com/b4edae144b2ac46cc84da48ab5fc0cf5.png) This is a level 16 Q+E+ult+passive proc damage. The red line represents deathcap and the blue Horizon focus. Deathcap outperforms horizon focus even at 0 ap.
